facts.statement: Free Realms took part in a Child's Play 2010 charity promotion running 21 to 31 December, where special in-game items could be bought with Station Cash.
facts.quote: A partir de 21 au 31 décembre, Sony Online Entertainment continu de soutenir la noble cause avec des objets spécials en jeu que vous pouvez acheter avec Station Cash.

article_summaries.title: Child's Play 2010!
article_summaries.summary: An SOE news post (French-language text on the archived page) announcing the Child's Play 2010 charity promotion. From 21 to 31 December, Station Cash purchases of special in-game items supported the charity, with SOE donating $10 per purchase up to a $50,000 maximum. Free Realms' promotional item was a domestic penguin pet, one of several items across SOE's games.
